fact_check.claim: Freestanding microwave prohibited outside Townhouse apartments

fact_check.claim: Medication row in table: 'Cornell says not to ship it with other items'
fact_check.note: Sources say not to ship medication as an emergency or time-sensitive item through the service centers, and that Cornell recommends sending it to the Cornell Health Pharmacy. Neither page says anything about shipping it 'with other items'. The same phrase is attributed to Cornell in the table and has no link.

fact_check.note: Address and refrigerated-prescription sentence match.

beats_top.query: cornell care package ideas what to send student
beats_top.why: The top results are generic or about Cornell College, with no Cornell University rules. Ours gives the address format, 50 lb limit, seven-day hold, perishables rules and the prohibited list, all linked to Cornell pages.
changes: Keep as is; optionally add a short note on Cornell's DormCo room-essentials ordering as an alternative to shipping.

fixes: Single-phrase repair for whoever publishes by hand: in the table row 'Medication', change 'Cornell says not to ship it with other items; see below' to 'Cornell says not to ship medication through the service centers; see below'; source https://scl.cornell.edu/sub/sub/residential-life/housing/housing-details/moving-campus/what-pack-what-not-bring and https://scl.cornell.edu/residential-life/service-centers-and-mail/best-practices-mail-and-packages
